title: SAMS Compass
description: A major-guidance platform for Sadat Academy students: every major broken down into real career paths with verified Egyptian salary ranges, a self-assessment, and an installable offline-first experience. Built end to end and shipped to campus.

title: Car Sales Performance Dashboard
description: NTI Data Analytics graduation project: a four-page, app-style Power BI report over 20.7K car sales transactions, with a custom dark theme, DAX measures and smooth navigation between Sales Overview, Customer Analysis and Performance pages. Built the dashboard end to end within a team of four.

title: Coffee Center Business Dashboard
description: An interactive Excel dashboard that turns 1,313 raw coffee-shop orders into one clear view of sales performance: automated cleaning and date logic with Power Query, a Power Pivot data model with DAX KPIs, and dynamic slicers for day, shift and payment type.

title: SAMS-MIS
description: The review hub for MIS courses at the academy's Assiut branch: summaries, question banks and mock exams for every subject, organized so students can find anything in seconds.
